ongoing.title: AI-Powered Adaptive Learning System
ongoing.description: Building a system that personalizes learning content and pacing to each learner in real time, adapting to individual strengths and gaps rather than a one-size-fits-all curriculum.

ongoing.title: NAVIS AI — Assistive Navigation for the Visually Impaired
ongoing.description: Continuing to develop NAVIS AI beyond its 1st-place competition win, extending the assistive navigation system to help visually impaired individuals move independently in more real-world environments.
